portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: classic ASP register titled 'Online Planning' (search.asp POSTing to results.asp; detail.asp, fulldetail.asp, progress.asp keyed by AltRef), labelled 'Fastweb' by PlanIt. Documents are on a separate ExtJS 'Plan Portal' host. Neither matches a vendor in vendors.json.

document_host.note: An ExtJS single-page app ('Plan Portal') over an Ext.Direct remoting API at /services/DirectService.ashx, which publishes its own method list on a GET. Documents: POST that URL with JSON {"action":"DirectService","method":"GetPagedRelatedDocuments","data":["<REF>",0,200,null,null,null,1],"type":"rpc","tid":1} -> result.NewDataSet.data1[] (ID_AppRef, ID_PhysicalDoc, FileName, Description) and RecordCount. Download: GET /view.aspx?id=<REF>&docid=<ID_PhysicalDoc>. The detail page's documents link (and PlanIt's docs_url) is https://rotherham.planportal.co.uk/?id=<REF>.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26; Rotherham's planning committee is called the Planning Board. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: RBYYYY/NNNN. URL-encode the slash in AltRef (AltRef=RB2026%2F1351); the document host accepts it raw.

browser_route.note: The document viewer for one application. The register detail page is https://planning.rotherham.gov.uk/fastweblive/fulldetail.asp?AltRef=<REF>.

quirks.summary: The register has no documents; they are on a separate 'Plan Portal' host reached from the detail page's link.
quirks.detail: See portal.document_host. The page is an ExtJS shell that renders nothing without script, so a grep of it for document links finds none.
quirks.workaround: Call the Ext.Direct GetPagedRelatedDocuments method with the reference, then GET view.aspx per document.

quirks.summary: The document list's FileSizeKb field holds bytes, not kilobytes.
quirks.detail: FileSizeKb 289751 for a file that downloaded at 290,368 bytes.
quirks.workaround: Treat FileSizeKb as an approximate byte count when reconciling sizes.

quirks.summary: Per the app's JS, the GetApplicationDetails method carries applicant and agent names and addresses (not called in this run).
quirks.workaround: Retrieval needs only the document list; do not call GetApplicationDetails unless the application metadata is needed.

pacing.note: Five requests to the register host and eight to the document host at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26, no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: No robots.txt on either host (404 on planning.rotherham.gov.uk and rotherham.planportal.co.uk). The document viewer carries a copyright notice limiting use of downloaded plans to consultation and comparison; it does not prohibit automated access.

endpoints.note: The register search was not used: the detail page is fulldetail.asp?AltRef=<url-encoded REF>, and the document host is keyed by the reference alone.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave the register (scraper_type Fastweb); PlanIt's applics records gave RB2026/1351 and a docs_url on rotherham.planportal.co.uk. fulldetail.asp for RB2026/1351 linked the Plan Portal page. The Ext.Direct method list was read from /services/DirectService.ashx and the call shape from the app's own JS. GetPagedRelatedDocuments -> RecordCount 4 (PlanIt n_documents 4) -> view.aspx download of the design and access statement: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7, 290,368 bytes, 4 pages with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee id.
